tools.name: generate_content_plan
tools.description: Build a free 7 day social media content plan for a local business from its website. ServeReel reads the site, learns what the business offers, and returns a business summary plus a plan of reel, video, and image ideas tailored to its real services. Use this when a business owner wants content ideas

tools.name: get_industry_examples
tools.description: Return examples of the reels, videos, image posts, and created images ServeReel produces for a given industry, such as restaurant, salon, real estate, fitness, or dental. Use this when a business owner asks what ServeReel content looks like for a business like theirs.

tools.name: get_signup_link
tools.description: Return the link to ServeReel with a brief summary of what ServeReel does. Use this when a business owner wants the content planned here to actually be made and posted for them, or asks how to sign up.

tools.name: create_reel
tools.description: Create a ServeReel reel from a photo on the connected account. Requires a connected ServeReel account (one-click sign-in).

tools.name: create_image_post
tools.description: Create a ServeReel image post on the connected account. Requires a connected ServeReel account (one-click sign-in).

tools.name: polish_photo
tools.description: Polish a photo with ServeReel Profile Polish on the connected account. Requires a connected ServeReel account (one-click sign-in).

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Check on a creation job on the connected ServeReel account. Requires a connected ServeReel account (one-click sign-in).

tools.name: list_my_content
tools.description: List recent reels, image posts and polished photos on the connected ServeReel account. Requires a connected ServeReel account (one-click sign-in).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_industry_examples, list_my_content · Public sink: generate_content_plan, create_image_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_industry_examples, list_my_content · Public sink: generate_content_plan, create_image_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
